title: Analytic spectral flow formula for unitaries and Levinson's theorem
summary: We prove an integral formula for the spectral flow of differentiable loops of unitaries of the form ${\rm Id}+$Schatten. Our formula is in terms of a regularised winding number, expressed in terms of exact differential forms, and we show how the formula extends to non-closed paths. Applying these ideas to the scattering operator of Schrödinger scattering systems yields explicit formulae for the number of bound states, possibly modified by the presence of resonances, of the system in terms of the potential.
